title: An over-budget section waits at four new observations and consolidates at five
source: new: TL-P4-39 B4/F4/F7; TL-P4-48 landed ledger grammar (b4c-fixtures)

inbox.line: Remember this: I want comparisons that say what is missing and keep each source apart, so a choice that is not sure stays not sure until I add the words that settle it.

between.line: Remember this too: I prefer to keep the amber gate clear when I plan garden work in Saltmere, and I do not want tools left on the path by the beds at any time of day.
